        <script><![CDATA[(function () {
    var qualityScore = parseFloat(current.getValue('quality_score')) || 0;
    var deliveryScore = parseFloat(current.getValue('delivery_score')) || 0;
    var quantityAccuracy = parseFloat(current.getValue('quantity_accuracy')) || 0;

    var totalScore = 0;
    var count = 0;

    if (qualityScore > 0) {
        totalScore += qualityScore;
        count++;
    }
    if (deliveryScore > 0) {
        totalScore += deliveryScore;
        count++;
    }
    if (quantityAccuracy > 0) {
        totalScore += quantityAccuracy;
        count++;
    }

    if (count > 0) {
        var overallScore = totalScore / count;
        current.setValue('overall_score', overallScore.toFixed(2));
    } else {
        current.setValue('overall_score', '0');
    }
})();
]]></script>
